mapper.sql: select r.id, r.order_id, r.farmer_id, r.buyer_id, r.rating, r.content, r.created_at, concat('订单#', o.id, ' - ', fp.name) as order_info, fp.name as product_name, su1.username as farmer_name, su2.username as buyer_name from reviews r left join orders o on r.order_id = o.id left join farmer_product fp on o.product_id = fp.id left join sys_user su1 on r.farmer_id = su1.id left join sys_user su2 on r.buyer_id = su2.id
mapper.select: where r.farmer_id = #{farmerId} order by r.created_at desc
where r.buyer_id = #{buyerId} order by r.created_at desc
mapper.delete:
delete from reviews where id in
#{id}
